Work: Review own changes; report symptoms; confirm context; follow approved care steps
Data needed: Own observations, personal baseline, pending actions and data freshness
Documented responsibility / proposal: Receives explanations and can request help
Privacy and authority boundary: Role-based access is a proposed implementation, not a NASA-approved permission matrix

Work: Assist another crew member; perform trained assessments; manage follow-up
Data needed: Relevant clinical observations, procedures and available supplies
Documented responsibility / proposal: Assigned mission role; physician qualification is not required by the standard
Privacy and authority boundary: Care relationship, delegation and mission policy determine access

Work: Coordinate task changes and mission response
Data needed: Necessary readiness constraints, task availability and operational status
Documented responsibility / proposal: Operational responsibility must be distinguished from clinical authority
Privacy and authority boundary: No blanket access to private mood, genetics or clinical notes proposed

Work: Review longitudinal changes, assess and coordinate clinical care
Data needed: Authorized clinical packet, trends, missingness and relevant history
Documented responsibility / proposal: Ground medical support continues despite greater onboard autonomy
Privacy and authority boundary: Asynchronous delivery, receipt and review must be distinct states

Work: Monitor medical hardware and coordinate requirements and communications
Data needed: Device health, collection completeness, scheduled medical activities
Documented responsibility / proposal: Technical role works closely with flight surgeon
Privacy and authority boundary: Technical access need not expose all clinical content

Work: Conduct private psychological support and review concerns
Data needed: Authorized questionnaires, private communications and relevant sleep/workload context
Documented responsibility / proposal: Psychological communication has separate scheduling/privacy requirements
Privacy and authority boundary: Keep psychological detail separate from general crew readiness views

Work: Plan and review strength, conditioning and rehabilitation
Data needed: Authorized fitness results, exercise adherence and recovery context
Documented responsibility / proposal: Supports preflight, inflight and postflight health
Privacy and authority boundary: Exercise data sharing needs purpose and policy

Work: Interpret exposure context and support mission radiation response
Data needed: Instrument, location, shielding, time window and personal-dose data when authorized
Documented responsibility / proposal: Environmental monitoring and personal exposure assessment differ
Privacy and authority boundary: Mission procedure determines response, not a generic LLM suggestion

Work: Collect consented study data and maintain provenance
Data needed: Approved study samples, assays, metadata and access conditions
Documented responsibility / proposal: Research and operational care records have different purposes
Privacy and authority boundary: Public research release does not grant access to operational health records

Data needed: Technical logs, sync state, software versions and keys under policy
Documented responsibility / proposal: Administrator is a proposed software support role
Privacy and authority boundary: Operational privilege must not imply routine access to medical plaintext
